name: was-benchmark-dimensions
description: A dataset of annotated evaluation dimensions intended to characterize model outputs along multiple axes (e.g., harm, ambiguity, intent, etc.). It provides standardized labels/metadata that researchers can use to compare system behaviour across safety- and alignment-relevant properties rather than evaluate a single task. The dataset is intended for annotation and classification-style analyses of model responses.
reputation: Niche dataset with limited but growing use in AI-safety and alignment research communities.
